info.name: NEXUS - Fraud Service
info.description: AI-powered fraud detection. All endpoints are internal (not exposed to end users). Handles direct analysis, decision retrieval, merchant blacklisting, compliance review outcomes, SAR filing, and real-time metrics. Port: 8087

request.description:
Direct AI fraud analysis bypassing Kafka. Used for emergency cases, compliance 'what-if', and integration testing.

Request: FraudAnalysisRequest {
  transactionId, sagaId, userId, sourceAccountId, targetAccountId,
  amount: BigDecimal, currency, transactionType, description,
  merchantId, merchantName, merchantCategoryCode,
  sourceIp, deviceFingerprint, isKnownDevice: boolean,
  accountAgeDays: int, totalTransactionCount: int,
  preComputedSignals: Map<String,Object>, traceId
}

Response 200: FraudDecisionResponse {
  decisionId, transactionId, userId, sourceAccountId, targetAccountId,
  amount, currency, transactionType,
  decisionOutcome: APPROVE | REJECT | REVIEW,
  riskScore: BigDecimal (0.0-1.0), confidenceLevel: BigDecimal,
  recommendedAction, reviewPriority: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL,
  reasoning: String, toolsCalled: List<String>,
  analysisStartedAt, analysisCompletedAt, analysisTimeMs: int,
  modelUsed, traceId, reviewedBy, reviewOutcome, reviewNotes, reviewedAt,
  sarFiled: boolean, sarReference, createdAt
}

item.name: Get Fraud Decision by Transaction ID

request.description:
All fraud decisions for a user, newest first. Used by compliance officers.

Response 200: Page<FraudDecisionResponse>

All REVIEW decisions awaiting compliance officer action. Sorted HIGH priority first, then oldest first.

Response 200: List<FraudDecisionResponse>

Add a merchant to the Redis blacklist. Immediate effect — next transaction to this merchant is blocked.

Response 200: { merchantId, action: 'BLACKLISTED', effectiveImmediately: true, blacklistedAt, blacklistedBy }

Remove a merchant from the blacklist (used if incorrectly blacklisted).

Response 200: { merchantId, action: 'REMOVED_FROM_BLACKLIST', removedAt, removedBy }

Real-time fraud processing statistics for Grafana dashboard.

Response 200: {
  lastHour: { total, approves, rejects, reviews, rejectionRatePercent },
  pendingReviewCount: int,
  sarsFiledLast24h: long,
  generatedAt: String
}
